page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg9ae.48xlarge is a dedicated bare metal instance type within the ECS Bare Metal server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by AMD EPYC 9T95 processors operating at a nominal clock frequency of 2.25 GHz. The server provisions 192 dedicated virtual CPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory, which establishes a standard 1:4 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. As an enterprise bare metal host, it bypasses hypervisor resource contention, offering direct access to underlying hardware execution threads.

Hardware configurations exclude integrated local disk storage and GPU hardware acceleration, meaning all persistent data and operating system installations must rely on attached remote cloud storage. In terms of network throughput, the host features a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, providing substantial capacity for inter-node communication and network-based storage protocols. It includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external IP configuration for internet egress and ingress.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory architecture positions this bare metal host primarily for horizontal enterprise scale, heavy container orchestration, distributed microservices, batch processing, and large-scale web application infrastructure that requires substantial compute density alongside robust 100 Gbps network connectivity.

The dense multi-core profile suits compute-heavy workloads, massive container clusters, backend microservices, and distributed application hosting.
